newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Commonwealth Bank preferred CFM buyer.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Commonwealth Bank preferred CFM buyer.

text.p: Australia Finance Minister John Fahey said Commonwealth Investment Services Ltd, a Commonwealth Bank of Australia Ltd subsidiary, had been chosen as preferred bidder for the government's investment manager, CFM Ltd.
Towers Perrin, which Fahey described as asset consultants, were the preferred bidder for a CFM subsidiary, Total Risk Management (TRM).
"The preferred bidders still have to complete some final due-diligence checks, and final sales contract negotiations are expected to be concluded prior to Christmas," he said.
"I have been very encouraged by the strong bidding interest for both CFM and TRM and I believe that the preferred bidders have excellent credentials to become the future owners of CFM and TRM."
The government said in May it would sell CFM, formerly Commonwealth Funds Management.
Fahey did not disclose a price.
